summary: The inequality holds for every k with p_(k+1) <= 1.000e+21; 683532 prime powers with exponent >= 3 located, 1367199811 square witnesses exhibited.

squares.witness_rule: q=2: 5; q<300: least prime > q^2; otherwise first prime N=P*m+1 in (q^2,q'^2), P over the 32 largest primes <= q (descending, stop when 2P<=q'), m even ascending; fallback least prime > q^2
